description: Use this when the user likes a finished seedance-2.5 DRAFT (480p) and wants it in 1080p: it renders the same video (same motion, framing and sound, sharper) as a new 1080p job. Takes only the draft's job_id; everything else comes from the draft. IMPORTANT — cost: 750 credits per second of the draft's length (plus 375 per second of any reference video the draft used), e.g. a 5s draft's final ≈ 3,750 credits; check_generation_status on the draft shows the exact standard price. Confirm with the user first. Works for 7 days after the draft was made. Charged on success only. Returns a new job_id — poll check_generation_status every 15–30 seconds, then share the finished video link.

job_id.description: The DRAFT's video job_id (a uuid): from generate_video with draft: true, or a draft the user made in the BudgetPixel Video Workshop. check_generation_status on it says whether it can still be finalized and what the final costs.
